cover.total.name: Total Cover
cover.total.summary: Can't be targeted directly by an attack or targeted spell.

mounted.eligible-mount.name: Eligible Mount
mounted.eligible-mount.summary: A willing creature at least one size larger than you, with a suitable anatomy, can serve as a mount.

mounted.mount-dismount.name: Mounting & Dismounting
mounted.mount-dismount.summary: During your move, mounting or dismounting a creature within 5 feet costs movement equal to half your Speed (round down).

mounted.controlled-mount.name: Controlled Mount
mounted.controlled-mount.summary: A mount trained to accept a rider shares your Initiative and can take only the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action.

mounted.independent-mount.name: Independent Mount
mounted.independent-mount.summary: An untrained mount keeps its own place in Initiative and moves and acts on its own.

mounted.falling-off.name: Falling Off
mounted.falling-off.summary: If your mount is forced to move, or you or it is knocked Prone, succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity save or fall off Prone within 5 feet.

underwater.melee-underwater.name: Melee Attacks
underwater.melee-underwater.summary: Without a Swim Speed, melee weapon attack rolls have Disadvantage unless the weapon deals Piercing damage.

underwater.ranged-underwater.name: Ranged Attacks
underwater.ranged-underwater.summary: A ranged weapon attack automatically misses a target beyond normal range, and has Disadvantage within normal range.

underwater.fire-resistance.name: Fire Resistance
underwater.fire-resistance.summary: Anything underwater has Resistance to Fire damage.

attack-situation.unseen-target.name: Unseen Target
attack-situation.unseen-target.summary: When you attack a target you can't see, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

attack-situation.unseen-attacker.name: Unseen Attacker
attack-situation.unseen-attacker.summary: When a creature can't see you, you have Advantage on attack rolls against it.

attack-situation.ranged-in-melee.name: Ranged in Melee
attack-situation.ranged-in-melee.summary: A ranged attack roll has Disadvantage while you are within 5 feet of an enemy who can see you and isn't Incapacitated.

attack-situation.long-range.name: Long Range
attack-situation.long-range.summary: A weapon attack roll against a target beyond normal range has Disadvantage; beyond long range it can't be made.

vision.dim-light.name: Dim Light
vision.dim-light.summary: Dim Light is Lightly Obscured: Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see in it, and passive Perception −5.

vision.darkness.name: Darkness
vision.darkness.summary: Darkness is Heavily Obscured: you have the Blinded condition when trying to see in it; you fail checks that need sight and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

vision.darkvision.name: Darkvision
vision.darkvision.summary: Within its range you see in Dim Light as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light (in shades of gray).

action.help.name: Help
action.help.effect: Ally gains Advantage on next attack or check

action.influence.name: Influence
action.influence.effect: Cha/Wis check to sway a creature's attitude

action.magic.name: Magic
action.magic.effect: Cast a spell or use a magic item or feature

action.utilize.name: Utilize
action.utilize.effect: Use a nonmagical object needing an action

action.object-interaction.name: Interact with an Object
action.object-interaction.effect: Draw, stow or open one object per turn

action.grapple.name: Grapple
action.grapple.effect: Unarmed Strike: Str/Dex save or Grappled

action.shove.name: Shove
action.shove.effect: Unarmed Strike: Str/Dex save → push 5 ft or Prone

action.opportunity-attack.name: Opportunity Attack
action.opportunity-attack.effect: Enemy leaves melee reach without Disengaging
